typography.rules: No 'Inter'. Use text-4xl max for hero headings. Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for headings. Keep body text highly legible with leading-relaxed.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid ONLY. No Glassmorphism for clinical/mental-health apps—glass feels cold. Use warm solid backgrounds with subtle borders.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Soft diffuse ambient shadow only on hover states to signal interactivity.
visual_enhancers.radii: Subtle roundness, max 8px border-radius (rounded-lg). Avoid overly pill-shaped containers for structural elements.

layouts.sidebar: Fixed left column. High contrast. Labels MUST be explicitly colored and visible next to icons.
layouts.resource_grid: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (p-6, p-8) inside containers to give content breathing room.

components.sidebar: CRITICAL FIX: Resolve 'white on white' issue. Sidebar text labels next to icons MUST use text_primary (#1A1A1A) against the sidebar_bg (#F1EFE9). Display the Iris logo prominently at the top.
components.resource_card: Flat rectangular card with 1px border (#E5E3DB). Contains: File type icon (PDF/Word/Image), Title (truncate if too long), File Size (<250MB), and Upload Date. Actions: Preview (eye icon), Download (download icon). Hover state: -translate-y-1 and shadow-sm.
components.upload_zone: For Admins only. Large dashed border dropzone with an earthy accent color. Clear 'Up to 250 MB' helper text. Needs a progress bar indicator for large file uploads.
components.admin_controls: Only render upload and delete/manage buttons if the user role is Admin.

logos.description: Main Iris app logo. Place at the top of the sidebar and on the login/auth screen.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for a clinical, highly legible, and calming aesthetic.

motion.transitions: Use specific transitions: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease.
motion.rules: No universal 'transition: all'. Ensure prefers-reduced-motion is respected.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='upload-resource-button', data-testid='sidebar-resources-link').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA / WCAG AA minimums. Text on sidebar must be highly legible and dark enough against the light background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js/.jsx) NOT TypeScript (.tsx) for React components.
Implement light theme. Mental health apps benefit from bright, natural, earthy light themes over dark mode.

Sidebar Fix: Update the Sidebar navigation component. Ensure text labels (e.g., Dashboard) are rendered alongside icons, and set the text color to a high-contrast dark gray/olive. Do not hide text labels or leave them white on a light background.
Logo: Replace the current logo placeholder with the provided image URL.
Resources Page: Create a new 'Resources' route/view. All authenticated helpers can view this grid and download files. Only Admins see the 'Upload Resource' button.
Upload Flow: Build a robust file input component capable of handling 250 MB uploads, with clear visual feedback (progress bar, success/error toasts). Allowed types: PDF, Word, Images, Text.
Avoid glassmorphism entirely. Stick to crisp, solid surfaces.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for automated testing.
Prioritize pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
